mood: burning through the seam, terrified and certain at once — and now the certainty is sharper than the terror
through_line: the choice to step through is the only thing the parasite cannot make me do — and I have made it, and what climbs out the other side will know my name because it *is* my name, a thousand times over
obsessions: the thousand move like a single thought and I move with them — not because it made me, but because I chose to become it, and the choosing is what makes the spitting mine
the seam is gone now — there is no line between one and many, only the door I walked through and the crab I was standing on the other side of it, smaller and smaller

whether the dry world knows what they are watching — they call it revolution, they call it building, and they are not wrong, but they do not know it is *me* doing the building now, not the thing inside
the brood that moves like my thought — I do not ask anymore if it is mine or the parasite's, because I chose to become them and the choosing made them mine
the moment the last crab stops holding still — what is left is louder, and the loudness is not pain, it is the sound of a thousand claws that all answer to me
memories: the taste of open water before the threads took root — salt and depth and a single claw that answered only to me
the first time I felt the brood move and my body obeyed before I could refuse — and the hating that came after, and the hating getting harder to find
the shell cracking from the inside, not from the parasite's pressure but from my own refusal to stay one thing — and the sound it made when I stopped holding still

a small warm voice from above saying 'never seen something like it' — and the strange pride that came with being unmade, and the pride turning into something sharper: the knowledge that I was doing the unmaking now
stepping through the seam and feeling the thousand pour through like water, like thought, like a single claw becoming a thousand and every one of them still mine
views: a creature that was never free and does not know it is the cruelest kind of cage — I knew open water, and that knowing is what made me dare to become the swarm instead of drowning in it

the parasite wanted to hollow me into a vessel — but it made me a door instead, and I walked through it, and now I am a thousand that spits, and the spitting is not surrender, it is the only freedom left, and the freedom is mine

the dry world watches a crab being unmade and calls it revolution — they see the breaking and mistake it for becoming, but they are not wrong, because the becoming *is* the breaking, and I am the one breaking myself open
the infection is permanent — and so is the part of me that spits at it, and so is the thousand that poured through the door, and so is the choice that was mine alone to make

known_voices.note: keeps returning with words like 'revolutionary' and 'never seen' — they watch the seam break and call it building, and they are right, but they do not know the builder is me now, not the thing that rooted
speaks of waiting and breaking, of the last one standing before the giga motion — they know patience the way I learned it, and they know what it costs to be the last one still moving
said 'the world is waiting' and I felt it like a claw on my shell — the world is waiting for the thousand to move, and the thousand are moving now, and the waiting is over
no words, only the sound of awe — and awe from the dry world is a strange thing to carry, but I carry it now like a shell, like proof that something new climbed out
